panels.title: Staple path: cold start → scan → paid
Cold start to paid, no tap (ms)
panels.description: First payment of a process, scanned, paid without confirmation. The number to watch from release to release.

targets.rawSql:
select app_version as "version", platform, count(*) as payments,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as p50, round(percentile_cont(0.75) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as p75, round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as p90
from telemetry_events
where name = 'payment' and measures ? 'process_to_outcome_ms' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1, 2 order by 1 desc, 2

panels.title: Stages by wallet (ms, p50 / p90)
panels.description: Machine time only. Prepared is the wallet's quote; submit→outcome is settlement.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet, count(*) as payments,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'qr_to_admitted_ms')::numeric)) as "decode→admitted p50", round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'qr_to_admitted_ms')::numeric)) as "p90",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'admitted_to_prepared_ms')::numeric)) as "admitted→prepared p50", round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'admitted_to_prepared_ms')::numeric)) as "p90 ",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as "submit→outcome p50", round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as "p90  "
from telemetry_events
where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1 order by 2 desc

select date_trunc('day', received_hour) as time, 'p50' as metric, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as value
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and measures ? 'submit_to_outcome_ms' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1
union all
select date_trunc('day', received_hour), 'p90', round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric))
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and measures ? 'submit_to_outcome_ms' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1
order by 1

panels.title: Launch: process start to first camera frame and wallet ready (ms)
panels.description: iOS counts from app initialisation, not process start.

targets.rawSql:
select app_version as "version", platform, count(*) as launches,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_first_frame_ms')::numeric)) as "first frame p50", round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_first_frame_ms')::numeric)) as "first frame p90",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'wallet_ready_ms')::numeric)) as "wallet ready p50", round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'wallet_ready_ms')::numeric)) as "wallet ready p90"
from telemetry_events where name = 'launch' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1, 2 order by 1 desc, 2

panels.title: Payment attempts per day by outcome
Outcome and error mix by wallet
panels.description: rejected = stopped before the wallet was asked; unknown = the wallet gave no verdict.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet, dimensions->>'outcome' as outcome, dimensions->>'error' as error,
  count(*) as attempts,
  round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) over (partition by dimensions->>'wallet'), 1) as "% of wallet"
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1, 2, 3 order by 1, 4 desc

panels.title: Scanner by device model (first session, ms)
panels.description: first frame→code includes aiming. frames × ms per frame is the decode work; the rest is the user. Compare variants on the same device only. Frame figures are Android only.

targets.rawSql:
select device_model as device, dimensions->>'camera_variant' as variant, count(*) as scans,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'camera_start_to_first_frame_ms')::numeric)) as "start→first frame p50",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'first_frame_to_qr_ms')::numeric)) as "first frame→code p50",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'frames_analyzed')::numeric)) as "frames p50",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'frame_analysis_avg_ms')::numeric)) as "ms per frame p50",
  max((measures->>'frame_width')::int) || 'x' || max((measures->>'frame_height')::int) as frame
from telemetry_events
where name = 'scan' and dimensions->>'session' = 'first' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1, 2 having count(*) >= $min_scans order by 3 desc

panels.title: Onboarding funnel (new installations)
panels.description: Each step is sent once per installation. Installations that updated from 1.1 are not in it.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'source' as source, dimensions->>'confirmation' as confirmation, count(*) as payments,
  round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) over (), 1) as "%"
from telemetry_events
where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' in ('paid', 'failed', 'unknown', 'dismissed') and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1, 2 order by 3 desc

panels.title: Fake doors
panels.description: Installations, not taps: each is counted once.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'door' as door,
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'shown') as shown,
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'tapped') as tapped,
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'tapped')
    / nullif(count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'shown'), 0), 1) as "% tapped"
from telemetry_events where name = 'fake_door' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})
group by 1 order by 2 desc
